title: fix: recover plugin updates when files are held
body:
Fixes #169842

Supersedes #170993, thanks @libaojiang.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: a held file can interrupt plugin replacement after the old installation has been partially removed, leaving its manifest missing and preventing a normal retry.

## User Impact

Failed updates restore missing files without overwriting files still held by another process. The error explains how to retry. If recovery cannot complete, it names the retained backup instead of discarding it. Updating does not require uninstalling the plugin or removing its configuration.

## Why This Change Was Made

The package-directory transaction already owns displacement, backup, and rollback. Its copy fallback can publish a complete backup before source cleanup fails. Rollback previously treated the remaining original directory as an unexpected replacement. It now verifies the original directory identity, backfills only missing entries under the existing recovery authority, and uses the existing settlement/backup cleanup path. Existing files and symlinks are never overwritten. After displacement completes, the transaction retires the original directory identity: a successor can reuse the same inode and must never be mistaken for a partially removed original. This keeps incomplete-recovery details and the retained backup intact when a deferred validation rejects the update.

The resolved-version comparison and explicit newer-release guidance for retained pins are already present on main; their existing coverage is included in validation. This change preserves that policy.

Simplification removes two single-caller helpers with redundant indirection. Production: +47/-21 (net +26); tests: +126/-16 (net +110); documentation: +6. The remaining growth implements partial-tree recovery and its actionable error without adding configuration, schema, dependency, or public API changes. Release note: plugin updates recover safely from held files and preserve a usable old installation, with thanks to @libaojiang.

## Evidence

- Red on the unmodified base: both held-file regressions failed with the original “install target changed during rollback” error and a retained backup. They cover an intact original and partial removal including nested files and the plugin manifest.
- Additional regressions require the actual recovery-failure reason and verify that disk failure or lost recovery authority retains the complete backup.
- Live local proof used an isolated HOME and OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR, a synthetic Git plugin, the production install/update command modules, and a real macOS immutable-file EPERM (`chflags uchg`). The held update returned one actionable error, restored version 1.0.0 including its manifest and Git metadata, and did not leak a new backup. After `chflags nouchg`, the same update reported `Updated held-update-proof: 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0.` Final backup count: zero.
- The normal `pnpm openclaw` source bootstrap could not verify offline runtime-publication state before installation; the live proof therefore ran `node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/live-cli.ts install` and `node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/live-cli.ts update`. That small local harness called `runPluginInstallCommand` / `runPluginUpdateCommand` directly, without mocks. Native Windows handle sharing was not run on this macOS host; EBUSY/EPERM regression injection covers the same filesystem boundary.
- Core typecheck passed: `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`.
- `node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/check-madge-import-cycles.ts`: 0 cycles. Touched-file format, MDX, and `git diff --check` passed. Independent Codex review found no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- The required cross-consumer run passed: 234 tests in 11 files across hooks, infrastructure, and E2E (321.23 s wall including build/compiler preparation). Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/install-package-dir.test.ts src/hooks/update.test.ts src/hooks/installs.test.ts src/hooks/install-policy-warning.test.ts src/infra/install-package-dir.manifest.test.ts src/infra/install-package-dir.rollback.test.ts src/plugins/install.managed-npm-authority.e2e.test.ts src/plugins/management-service.install-compensation.test.ts src/cli/plugins-update-command.authority.integration.test.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/missing-configured-plugin-install.test.ts src/plugins/update.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`, with isolated HOME and OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR. The four new cases took 119 ms combined; native npm preparation E2E took 7.87 s of test time. The first consumer attempt was invalidated by a source edit during compilation and ran no tests; the final frozen-source run above passed. The CI follow-up below covers the reported Linux regression.
- Final touched-file lint passed: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig tsconfig.json src/infra/install-package-dir.ts src/infra/install-package-dir.rollback.test.ts`. Initial lint identified parameter reassignment and the file-length limit; both were corrected without suppressions.
- Used the campaign's targeted local gate route; the slow `check:changed` SQLite inventory was omitted. PR CI supplies broad proof. No remote lease was created.

CI repair for the held head:

- Fetched each failed job log once: `118861046712` and `118861046512`. The rollback failure was an inode-reuse bug: after successful displacement, recovery could mistake a new directory for the old one, backfill the successor, remove the backup, and return only `backup rejected`. Clearing the original identity after successful displacement fixes the owner state; the original incomplete-recovery assertions remain and now also cover forced inode reuse and absence of backfilled files in the successor.
- Deterministic red proof on the previous production code: the forced-reuse case failed with `{ ok: false, error: 'backup rejected' }`, missing `recoveryIncomplete` and the retained-backup message. It passes with the production lifecycle fix.
- With the integrated main base `73f2bf22959c26cc49fd5fd8533084badab2bd08`, on Node 26.12.0 and the pinned Bun runtime, `OPENCLAW_VITEST_RUNTIME=<runtime> node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/install-package-dir.rollback.test.ts src/commands/doctor-database-network-storage.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed all 31 tests. Node: 55.14 s total; rollback 27.10 s (91% transform, 7% tests), Doctor 23.94 s (83% transform). Bun: 18.08 s total; rollback 6.77 s, Doctor 8.68 s. Tests used isolated HOME and OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR.
- The exact failed ratchet was `mock-exports`, at `src/commands/doctor-database-network-storage.test.ts:15`. It was inherited from the CI base and already fixed on main by `2466488c29e25f6fdafe0d6419387116e4194ade` using an `importOriginal` spread. Integrated that upstream fix; no baseline expansion. `check-test-mock-exports.mts --base origin/main --no-merge-base` passes on both Node and Bun: 7,980 grandfathered factories.
- Line-cap and assertion-safety ratchets also pass on both runtimes: 2 changed source files with no over-cap growth; 2,504 files / 5,743 grandfathered assertions. The strict local max-lines ratchet reports inherited suppressions in `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-message.test.tsx`, `ui/src/pages/config/config-page-state.ts`, and `ui/src/pages/sessions/sessions-page-state.ts`. All three are identical to main; the CI job treated them as advisory and passed that step. No suppressions or baseline entries were added by this PR.
- Fresh touched-file type-aware lint passed, and the independent Codex review found no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Fresh consumer replay on Node passed 205 tests in the other 10 files from the original consumer command (249.77 s wall, including 151.5 s of runtime build preparation). The infrastructure shard took 46.72 s; the real npm E2E file took 12.34 s including 8.949 s of tests. Together with the 31 focused Node tests above, all 236 tests in the 12 relevant files passed. The same isolated HOME and OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR were used.
- Re-ran core typecheck (`node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`), touched-file type-aware lint, oxfmt, `git diff --check`, and Madge (0 cycles): all passed. Ratchets above used `origin/main` pinned to the integrated base at execution time.
- Immediately before publishing, fetched main and verified #169842 remains open and no newer main commit changes the install-package-directory owner. This follow-up adds 2 production lines and net 15 test lines; the complete PR remains net +26 production / +110 tests / +6 docs.
